ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels. Light pixels are concentrated on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and tips are primarily low-intensity. Lateral lobes display dense high-intensity mottling. A distinct low-intensity diagonal band is visible on the right lobe intersecting the high-intensity mottled region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped vertex with an estimated pixel angle of 68 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels. The left lobe trailing edge displays significantly higher amplitude irregularity compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature of the outer margins, with increasing slope towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete high-intensity circular clusters (approx. 3-6 pixels in diameter) localized in the dark central pigmentation of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent low-intensity linear feature on the right lobe, oriented diagonally at approximately -45 degrees from the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular tissue void and deep jagged notches on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe; distal tip of the right lobe shows minor terminal erosions.
other_distinctive_markers: High-variance 'salt-and-pepper' transition zones at the interface of dark and light pigmentation areas.
